name: Polaris RZR Turbo - 4 Seater
cardPhotoAlt: Side profile of a Polaris RZR four seater dune buggy in the Dubai desert
heroPhotoAlt: Black Polaris RZR turbo four seater dune buggy on the Dubai red dunes
blurb: Turbo power with four seats, for groups that want the quicker machine without splitting up.

durations.label: 30 minutes
durations.blurb: The lowest commitment. Enough to learn the controls and cross a few dune faces on the Polaris RZR Turbo 4-Seater.

durations.label: 1 hour
durations.blurb: The sweet spot for most riders. Time to settle into the Polaris RZR Turbo 4-Seater and get a proper run at the red dunes.

durations.label: 2 hours
durations.blurb: A longer route with more varied terrain and photo stops, for riders already comfortable on the Polaris RZR Turbo 4-Seater.
